name: PeelGallery
description: PeelGallery is a simple Homebrew application for the PS Vita; it acts as an intuitive visual frontend (gallery) for easily managing and swapping the lock screen wallpapers handled by the Fruitpeel plugin.
long_description:
The application reads compatible images on your console and lets you browse them in a grid view. Selecting an image automatically replaces the Fruitpeel system file and restarts the console to apply the change.

Features:
Preview Grid: Optimized (2x2) caching system ensures you never run out of RAM, regardless of how many backgrounds you have.
Dedicated LiveArea button: Clean installation with a custom LiveArea.
Quick installation: Install and apply in seconds.
How to use it on PS Vita?
Download the PeelGallery.vpk file and install it on your console using VitaShell.
Place your compatible images in the following path: ux0:/data/PeelGallery/
Open the application and navigate using the D-Pad, or use the L/R triggers to skip pages.
Press X to apply the background. The console will restart automatically, and your lock screen wallpaper will be updated.
